items.label: COMFORTABLE MATERIAL
items.value: Lusait wireless bras are made of ultra-soft and stretchy fabric, combining 52% Nylon and 48% Spandex, with lightweight, breathable, and seamless material that feels like your second skin. This fabric keeps you cool and comfortable all day long, providing cloud-like comfort with no wires,while also offering durable stretch that adapts to your body.

items.label: "W" JELLY BAND WIRELESS BRA
items.value: This seamless bra for women features innovative W-shaped "Jelly Bands". These unique bands provide full 360° support and lift for your breasts, molding to your body for light, comfortable support without traditional underwires. The flexible design ensures the bra adapts to your shape for a seamless, natural fit.

items.label: REMOVABLE PADDED INSERTS
items.value: This bralette comes with removable padded inserts, allowing you to adjust the level of support and shape. The stylish deep V-neck enhances your natural silhouette, providing a flattering look while ensuring a seamless fit under low-cut tops. The removable pads offer extra customization for a smooth, invisible fit.

items.label: ADJUSTABLE STRAPS & RACERBACK DESIGN
items.value: The adjustable straps are designed with powerful elasticity to relieve shoulder pressure and ensure a perfect fit. The straps prevent slippage and digging, offering all-day comfort. The racerback showcases delicate lace detailing that creates an attractive, feminine look that's meant to be seen under tank tops and open-back clothing.

items.label: FOR VARIOUS OCCASIONS
items.value: Perfect for home-office days, Everyday wear, and low-impact workouts such as yoga, Pilates, running, or stretching, jogging, hiking,. This bra also provides ultimate freedom for rest and relaxation, making it ideal for sleep.It’s lightweight, easy to pack, and offers the versatility you need for any occasion, from casual outings to travel.
